items:
The main living area is a wide open concept place with plenty of room for relaxation, dining and gathering with family. 2 bedrooms are on the 1st Floor, with the other 2 upstairs. The 3rd floor loft includes a convenient wet bar, perfect for making a cocktail before heading out on the balcony. From here you'll enjoy a bird's eye view of the neighborhood and 30A. There's plenty of room in this home to sleep up to 17 guests - perfect for multi-family and friend groups.

A stay at this home gives you access to all of the amazing amenities Seacrest Beach has to offer like an incredible resort pool, beautiful green spaces and seasonal beach tram service. We can't wait to welcome you to License to Chill.

Sleeping Arrangements:
1st Floor, Bedroom 1: Twin-over-twin bunk bed plus additional twin and twin trundle.
1st Floor, Bedroom 2: Queen bed, TV.
1st Floor, Living Room: Sofa pulls out to a queen bed
2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, twin sleeper chair, TV, balcony access. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.
2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: King bed, 2 twin sleeper chairs, TV, balcony access. Private bathroom with dual sinks, shower and jetted tub.
3rd Floor Loft: Sofa pulls out to a queen bed.

Beach Access:
Enjoy FREE tram service from March - October to (and from!) your beach access across 30A at Sunset Beach. Just walk to the nearest designated tram stop and call for pickup. The tram should arrive within 15 minutes. It runs 7 days a week, starting at 9 AM with the last pickup from the beach at 5:30 PM.
Distance: .4 miles | Time: 8 minutes walking

Seacrest Beach II:
The showstopper of the area is the 12,000 square-foot lagoon pool. With a waterfall, fountain, and children's splash area we know you'll find your perfect pool day at Seacrest. Surrounded by palm trees and poolside loungers, it might be hard to split your time between this pool and the beautiful Gulf.

Your stay at License To Chill comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!

* Sorry, no pets allowed.
* Parking for 3 cars.
* Golf carts are not allowed in the Seacrest Beach community.

A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.text:
It hurts me to write a bad review of any property in this beautiful neighborhood of Rosemary Beach. This is our fourth trip down and we love it! We chose a bigger house this year because we were traveling with my sister's family. Upon arriving we found construction trucks and workers with extremely loud hammers/saws working next to and in front of the property framing out a new home. All of the outdoor decks and grilling area were literally covered in sawdust and workers were leaning against the side of the house and visible along the bedroom windows. We immediately called before even opening the door and ask to be moved (offering to even pay a difference in pricing) and were told by a very rude agent that Benchmark is not responsible for construction around their properties. We ask to speak to a manager and were told no. This was disappointing especially considering it was not a busy time in Rosemary. The problems continued and we were woken at 7am each day to loud construction. It was not the relaxing vacation we expected! After many calls and emails, a professional manager did finally call us on the 3rd day but was unable to offer any solution except a 5% credit towards a future booking. 

The home itself was spacious and comfortable. It was however short bath and beach towels, extra garbage bags, and toilet paper, and there was not even salt in pepper left in the kitchen cabinets. It possibly was a new rental that needed to work out the kinks but that is usually something a management company would suggest and handle. Beware of booking with Benchmark Management.
reviews.title: Management Company's Fault

reviews.text: First day we got there we ate and put dishes in the dishwasher. Before bed we debated about running it but decided to wait until morning after breakfast. Next day after breakfast we started the dishwasher. And immediately we started smelling something burning and smoke was coming out. Then we opened it to make sure there was nothing melting and there wasn’t so we started it and it started burning again. So we opened it. And turned it off. But every time we tried to close the door it started burning again but if we left it open it the alarm on it would go off and not stop. We called the office number multiple times. The first time she told us that the problem had already been reported and they had a work order to fix it on Monday. It was Sunday. I am upset that my entire family which is My husband and I and our kids and grandkids could have burned up in a fire if we had run the dishwasher on Friday night and there was no note, no email, no text or phone call, that the dishwasher was broken and could catch on fire. No one thought to notify us, fix it, or even turn the breaker off. And we called on Monday many times and left messeges stating this is urgent. No answer and no one came on Monday. We called Tuesday, no answer and no one came. Wednesday we called and a guy came out. He opened the door panel and black debris fell out and the wires were melted. He turned turned the breaker. So no dishwasher for the week. Oven burned food on bottom before being done.
reviews.title: Bad appliances. Dishwasher caught on fire
